TikTok is without a doubt a powerful platform for retailers to showcase their products and connect with a younger demographic. 

In this article, we'll explore 10 proven TikTok marketing strategies that can fuel growth for retailers. Let's dive in and discover how you can leverage this dynamic platform to propel your retail business forward.

*   TikTok marketing includes tactics to increase brand awareness, advertise, sell products, collect feedback and much more.
*   TikTok marketing strategies can be implemented through 3 main areas: paid ads, influencer marketing and original content.
*   Before you start working on your strategies, focus on creating your TikTok Business account, identifying your target audience, creating a content plan, collecting product data for advertising (product feed) and researching your competitors.

* * *

## What is TikTok marketing?

TikTok marketing is the practice that involves [leveraging the TikTok platform](https://www.datafeedwatch.com/blog/tiktok-advertising-guide) and its content to promote a brand, products, and/or services to TikTok users. 

This can include tactics aiming to: 

*   increase brand awareness
*   advertise 
*   sell products and services
*   gather feedback from customers and audiences
*   and more!

TikTok marketing is becoming increasingly important for businesses of all sizes that are present on TikTok, allowing them to achieve big results and connect with their target audiences in new and engaging ways.

## What is TikTok Marketing strategy?

TikTok marketing strategy is the plan on how to tactically utilize the popular social media platform [TikTok to promote brands](https://www.highsocial.com/resources/is-tiktok-promotion-worth-it-pros-cons-and-insights/) and interact with potential customers using a variety of content formats. There are three primary areas where marketers can take advantage of TikTok using different strategies.

### Paid ads

Through TikTok For Business, brands can run in-feed ads, create branded hashtags, and develop video effects. Brands of all sizes are gravitating toward TikTok to create entertaining ads and engaging campaigns that resonate with users. 

The bidding/auction model for ad payment provides flexibility to advertisers, while the potential for high engagement rates and access to new audiences make TikTok ads an attractive option.

[![Get started with 15 days for free](https://hubspot-no-cache-na2-prod.s3.amazonaws.com/cta/default/246436727/interactive-366892772039.png)](https://www.datafeedwatch.com/hs/cta/wi/redirect?encryptedPayload=AVxigLJ7T0g8a0cyeB%2BMIkP1BFNuQpf%2BVjkfJ6Oeu6sNOU6hse7te7Iv6EmW%2FVau0lOhGlRUL6RCjal5IYZw%2F2f%2Bg5eYtkm9lt%2BKvBDGS23SFprzrWnUp9aXyMybgmgXyyu2OApYHttU%2FRcHusvImUkeOMgm4FkHMLB9%2B%2FrPc3B9HUlC6VMy10AMAW2g8cuaLZ5l6aTnqR6rjRg0LCm5lBDs&webInteractiveContentId=366892772039&portalId=246436727)

### Influencer marketing

Collaborating with influencers who have a deep understanding of the platform can be highly effective. These influencers can translate brand messages into engaging and creative content that resonates with their dedicated community. This form of marketing opens up new audiences, elevates brand awareness, and boosts engagement rates.

### Original content

While TikTok users appreciate original content, marketers don't always need to spend extensive time devising the next viral trend. Often, the best-performing TikToks are those that replicate or recreate existing trends. By exploring the app, identifying popular trends, and finding ways to align your brand with relatable and enjoyable videos, you can craft relevant and authentic content that resonates with your target audience.

TikTok marketing leverages the potential of this short-form video platform by utilizing influencer partnerships, original and relatable content, and paid ads to connect with potential customers, enhance brand awareness, and drive engagement.

# The Marketer's Guide to TikTok: Retail & E-Commerce

04 August, 2022

The Marketer's Guide to TikTok for Retail & E-Commerce brands has all the inspiration, creative tools and ad formats you need to engage your audience and build a winning TikTok strategy.

**71% of users said that TikTok has inspired them to shop even when they weren't looking to do so.**

  

On TikTok, users make it to the shopping cart through authentic and engaging content, not intrusive ads. The TikTok community is also highly engaged and eager to join in on brand conversations, which helps to amplify messaging and create a more meaningful relationship centred around brand loyalty.

  

To tap into this opportunity, retail & e-commerce brands should use TikTok to entertain their audiences along the purchase journey. To show you just how to do that, we've created the [Marketer's Guide to TikTok for Retail & E-Commerce brands](https://indd.adobe.com/view/acbc776f-341e-4501-9b15-bdfc15d7c6df). It's got all the inspiration, creative tools and ad formats you need to engage your audience and build a winning TikTok strategy.
